crons.description: Daily: mark bookings no-show when 48h after slot end has passed
1st of month: auto-complete pending bookings from previous month (§15)
1st of month: generate commission invoices for all active vendors
5th of month: first payment reminder to vendors with unpaid invoices
25th of month: second (final) payment reminder with deactivation warning
26th of month: deactivate vendors with unpaid invoices + apply 25% reinstatement penalty
